Actress Nushrat Bharucha Injured in Bali Accident

Bollywood actress Nushrat Bharucha suffered an accident in Bali, resulting in a fractured spine. She was immediately hospitalized and is scheduled for surgery in Mumbai. Plans are in place to bring her to India via air ambulance.
